notes.title: #41: The New Demo is Here – Experience the First Chapter
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome Back, Dear Followers of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i]![/h3][p]We’re beyond excited to share another major milestone with all of you who have been faithfully following the journey of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i]. Thank you for being part of this story - your support continues to mean the world to us! [/p][h3]Goodbye Old Prologue, Hello New Demo![/h3][p]
After a very promising round of internal playtests, we’ve made the decision to [b]retire the outdated prologue[/b] created by the former development team. It no longer reflects the direction and quality we’re striving for.[/p][p]Instead, we now invite you to experience [b]something truly new[/b] - a fresh take on the vision of [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i], built from the ground up by our current team.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Demo is Live - Play it Now![/h3][p]The wait is over - the [b]official demo is available right now[/b]! Just head over to our Steam page and [b]click the big green “Download” button[/b] to jump into the experience. We can't wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][h3]Share Your Thoughts - We’re Listening[/h3][p]We deeply value your feedback. Whether it’s a bug, a thought, or an idea, we want to hear it all. You can share your impressions [b]on the Steam forums[/b] or [b]reach out directly via email[/b] - every message will be read and considered by our team.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next? Even More Improvements Ahead![/h3][p]Thanks to your participation in the recent playtests, we’ve already made tons of improvements and we’re not stopping there. In the [b]next wave of playtesting[/b], you can expect:[/p][list][*][p]A more intense and enriched [b]encounter between Jesus and Satan[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue improvements[/b] aligned more closely with source material[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]quests and objectives[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And [b]much, much more[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We’re building something special together. Thank you for walking this path with us and as always, see you in the game![/p][p]The [i]I Am Jesus Christ[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #38: Open World
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’re back in full force, more committed than ever to advancing the development of [b]I Am Jesus Christ[/b]!

The break was due to a restructuring of our team earlier this year, which we believe has ultimately benefited the project. We've learned lessons from the years of work by the previous team and, most importantly, from your feedback on the Prologue. Having that in mind, we’re directing our focus towards the most anticipated areas of improvement for [b]I Am Jesus Christ[/b]. First up, we’re excited to introduce the game’s biggest design change:

[h2]Open World Exploration[/h2]

Until now, the Prologue’s events unfolded within limited spaces, constrained by both natural elements and invisible boundaries. To deepen the immersion and provide a sense of the environment in Jesus’ time, we’ve decided to open up the world. You will now be able to explore the regions of Galilee, Samaria, and Judea—covering nearly the entire journey of Christ’s ministry.

[h3]Nazareth and Surroundings[/h3]
Experience the town where Jesus lived with His family, where He learned His craft, connected with the people, and, after certain events, narrowly escaped being executed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/b976b83a6d4b376564c8eec9d63ecd124cd4b23b.gif[/img]

[h3]The Sea of Galilee[/h3]
Visit numerous historical locations along the shore and witness the miracles of Christ from a first-person perspective, reliving these incredible events up close. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/2706f2ae6e803d4a0beed0509766cceb3cd203cf.gif[/img]

[h3]The Judean Desert[/h3]
Encounter the rugged wilderness of Samaria and feel the vastness of the open landscape. Endure the 40-day fast and discover the banks of the Jordan River, where you’ll experience Christ’s baptism by John the Baptist. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/fd0c739c8b1e0097e2dcd34c2341d71ef1f28131.gif[/img]

[h3]The City of Jerusalem[/h3]
Immerse yourself in the bustling life of the largest historical city in the region. Explore its narrow streets in the heart of the city and see the most iconic locations around its ancient walls. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/35061bf0e1954ff6db676939dda8ae8cc75bf22b.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Well-Known Biblical Sites[/h3]
Take a journey to the other famous locations recreated from historical maps, engravings, and records, such as Mount Tabor, Cana, Nain, Sychar, and Bethany. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36310040/009d15b60b3b8f48bd49b2e7105cad0595374a7d.gif[/img]

Stay tuned here on Steam for more updates as we reveal further details about the project in the coming weeks. We can’t wait to share what’s next with you!
